submittedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a readable close crop of existing DooKnow CollectionWorkspace only, a standalone main-pane component on a plain white canvas. Image 1 gives exact main heading and three-column card geometry; Image 2 gives compact flat palette. Do not render any global header, app navigation or sidebar in this crop.
One coherent next-page ERROR state with retained list: eyebrow 我的笔记; main title 最近; 8 篇笔记; 按最近修改排序; refresh icon and 新建笔记 at top right. Retain three cards in one row: 知识与行动, 整理方法, 搭建自己的知识库. Each has a short fictional summary, folder path, modified time, star and … controls. Below cards display error 加载笔记失败 with enabled 重新加载 button. Footer 已加载 3 / 8 篇 and visibly disabled 加载更多笔记. Keep list/error/retry/disabled-pagination visible together. No skeleton, empty state, stale banner or end-of-list claim. Flat white #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa context sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 blue and #edf1ff selection. Crisp Chinese sans-serif, 8px corners, no texture/gradient. No source paths inside product. Metadata links this crop to owner recent host.
